_: Physical constants and reference conditions for the world the body lives in (gravity, air, temperatures, light, radiation, body temperatures). World lane 2026-11-07.

g_local_range_m_s2.src: WGS84 normal gravity (lat 45 D from the Somigliana formula)

free_air_gradient_per_m.src: WGS84 (per metre of height, in m/s2 per m)

STP_C.src: SI_REFS IUPAC STP (0 C, 100 kPa since 1982)

sound_water_37C_m_s.src: NISTWB (NIST Chemistry WebBook, IAPWS-95, 0.101325 MPa), re-read 11-08 in water.json: 1523.66 m/s at 37 C; 1524 holds (the src had cited CRC, recalled)

skin_surface_temperature_C.src: E: recalled from SKIN_TEMP (Ramanathan 1964 weighting / ISO 9886), not re-read: mean thermoneutral 33-34, hands/feet in a cool room 25-32, forehead 34-35 C

skin_emissivity.src: STEKETEE73 abstract re-read 11-08 (skin.body.json): 0.98 +/- 0.01, wavelength-independent over 1-14 um; Sanchez-Marin 2009 (SKIN_TEMP) not re-read

CODATA18.cite: CODATA 2018 recommended values (NIST): c = 299792458 m/s exact, sigma = 5.670374419e-8 W m-2 K-4 exact, k_B, standard atmosphere 101325 Pa, g_n = 9.80665 m/s2 (CGPM 1901)
CODATA18.lic: NIST, US government work, public domain

WGS84.cite: NIMA TR8350.2 World Geodetic System 1984 (3rd ed.): normal gravity 9.7803253359 m/s2 at the equator, 9.8321849378 at the poles; free-air gradient ~-3.086e-6 s-2

ISA.cite: ICAO Doc 7488 / ISO 2533:1975 International Standard Atmosphere: sea level 101325 Pa, 288.15 K, 1.225 kg/m3, 1.7894e-5 Pa s, 340.29 m/s
ISA.lic: standard copyright; defining constants used as facts

CRC.cite: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics (any recent edition): standard property tables for water, ice, air, oils. Values recalled as standard table values, not re-checked line by line this session
CRC.lic: copyright, paywalled; individual physical constants used as facts, no table copied

KOPP11.cite: Kopp G, Lean JL. A new, lower value of total solar irradiance: evidence and climate significance. Geophys Res Lett 38:L01706 (2011): TSI 1360.8 +/- 0.5 W/m2

MACKOWIAK92.cite: Mackowiak PA, Wasserman SS, Levine MM. A critical appraisal of 98.6 F... JAMA 268:1578-1580 (1992): mean oral 36.8 C (range 35.6-38.2); Wunderlich's 37.0 C

SKIN_TEMP.cite: Mean skin temperature at thermoneutral rest ~33-34 C (Ramanathan NL, J Appl Physiol 19:531, 1964 weighting; ISO 9886:2004); skin emissivity ~0.98 (Sanchez-Marin FJ et al., Phys Med Biol 54:4423, 2009). Recalled

SI_REFS.cite: Reference conditions: SI brochure (BIPM, 9th ed. 2019) kelvin; IUPAC STP 0 C / 100 kPa; NIST NTP 20 C / 1 atm; ISO 554 standard atmospheres for conditioning (20-23 C)
SI_REFS.lic: BIPM CC BY 3.0 IGO; others standard definitions used as facts

NISTWB.cite: NIST Chemistry WebBook, SRD 69: thermophysical properties of fluid systems (water: IAPWS-95 equation of state); 37 C, 0.101325 MPa sound speed 1523.66 m/s, re-read 11-08 (water.json)
NISTWB.lic: US government work (NIST Standard Reference Data); numbers used as facts

STEKETEE73.cite: Steketee J. Spectral emissivity of skin and pericardium. Phys Med Biol 18:686-694 (1973): skin 0.98 +/- 0.01 over 1-14 um (abstract re-read 11-08, skin.body.json)
STEKETEE73.lic: paywalled; abstract numbers used as facts

phase.src: SCHEMA: gas and light are non_colliding; constants: not a material; listed so every profile carries a solver phase
